desc:
🐾 My Pet Salon! 🛁✨

Open your very own pet salon and turn it into the cutest grooming empire in town!

Customers bring in their pets — fluffy puppies, cuddly cats, bunnies, turtles, hamsters and more. Wash them, brush out the knots, catch the fleas, blow-dry the fluff and finish with a cuddle. Every pet leaves happy, clean and adorable!

🧼 HOW IT WORKS
• Groom pets with satisfying hands-on mini-games: shampoo, brush, comb, blow-dry and cuddle
• Earn cash from every happy customer
• Buy new stations and upgrades to grow your salon
• Decorate your salon to make it your own

⭐ LEVEL UP & UNLOCK
• Every level unlocks something new: new tools, new moves, new pets
• Meet rarer customers with special looks
• Chain moves into combos for bigger rewards

🐶🐱🐰🐢🐹 ADORABLE PETS
Cute blocky pets with their own animations and personalities. Can you collect and groom them all?

🎁 Use codes for free rewards! Join the group to get new codes and be first to hear about updates.

👍 Like & favor
